nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Use Nexscope data to search and filter Amazon products, supporting multi-dimensional criteria including price, monthly sales, BSR ranking, gross margin, ratings, fulfillment method, badges, seller origin, and more across multiple Amazon marketplaces. Trigger when the user mentions Amazon product selection research, product filtering, sales filtering, product discovery, BSR analysis, niche product discovery, competitor analysis, market opportunity assessment, product-level market size estimation, gross margin screening, Nexscope product selection, Amazon product selection, sales filtering, BSR analysis, profit screening, market analysis, product selection tool. Even if the user does not explicitly mention "Nexscope", if their need involves filtering and analyzing Amazon product-level data for product selection, this skill should also be triggered.

badgeAmazonsChoice.description: Amazon's Choice badge filter: Y, N, or empty (all)

badgeBestSeller.description: Best Seller badge filter: Y, N, or empty (all)

badgeNewRelease.description: New Release badge filter: Y, N, or empty (all)

dataSnapshotMonth.description: Product data snapshot month, format yyyyMM (e.g. 202412 for December 2024 data snapshot), or nearly for last 30 days real-time data. Default: nearly. Used for historical analysis and period comparison; only supports existing historical snapshots, future dates are not supported; maxLength 1000

dimensionType.description: Package dimension type (codes vary by site, see below)

filterSubNode.description: Whether to filter subcategory nodes; only effective when nodeLabel or nodeIdPath has a value; pass JSON boolean true / false

fulfillment.description: Fulfillment method: single select AMZ / FBA / FBM, or multi-select such as AMZ,FBA, FBA,FBM, AMZ,FBA,FBM, etc.; multiple conditions use comma separation; empty means no limit

hideUnlistedProduct.description: Whether to hide delisted products, default true

keyword.description: Search keyword; translate to the corresponding country's language whenever possible, e.g. use English keywords for the US, German keywords for Germany, etc.; maxLength 10240

listedWithinLastMonths.description: Time since listing (months), only allowed: 1, 3, 6, 12, 24 (must match these enum values; do not pass other integers)

marketplace.description: Marketplace site code, default US. Only US, UK, DE, FR, JP, CA, IT, ES, MX, IN are allowed (must match this enum; AU, TR, and other unlisted sites are not supported)

matchType.description: Match type: 1 = phrase match (default), 2 = fuzzy match, 3 = exact match

maxAmzUnit.description: Maximum variant last-30-day sales volume (only supported for last 30 days queries); minimum 0

maxBsrGrowthCount.description: Maximum main category BSR growth count

maxRating.description: Maximum rating value (0-5), 3.8-4.3 is the product improvement opportunity range

maxSubNodeBsrRank.description: Highest subcategory BSR rank (requires filterSubNode = true)

maxUnitsGrowthRate.description: Maximum monthly sales volume growth rate, unit %

minAmzUnit.description: Minimum variant last-30-day sales volume (only supported when dataSnapshotMonth is a "last 30 days" type query); minimum 0

minSubNodeBsrRank.description: Lowest subcategory BSR rank (requires filterSubNode = true)

minUnitsGrowthRate.description: Minimum monthly sales volume growth rate, unit %

order.description: Sort configuration; if passed, it is recommended to provide both field and desc (both are required in the sub-schema)

order.field.description: Sort field: total_units (monthly sales), total_amount (monthly revenue), bsr_rank, price, rating, reviews, profit, reviews_rate, available_date, questions, total_units_growth, total_amount_growth, reviews_increasement, bsr_rank_cv, bsr_rank_cr, amz_unit (variant sales). Default total_units. Pass an empty string "" to not sort by the above business fields (full query sort semantics are handled by the server)

sellerNation.description: Seller location code (e.g. US, CN, HK), multiple conditions comma-separated, default no limit

showVariation.description: Whether to query variants: Y or N, default N

weightUnit.description: Weight unit: g, kg, oz, lb. This field must be specified if the parameters include weight filtering
